_comment: Conservative GTFS encodings of prescriptions that would otherwise generate illegal itineraries. direction_id 0 = as-printed (andata), 1 = reverse.

rules.why: divieto di esercizio locale Montevago<->S.Margherita: on andata the only upstream boarding point is Montevago, so alighting here is exactly the forbidden local trip
on ritorno, boarding here can only lead to Montevago (the terminus) — the forbidden local trip
